title: Exceptional coefficient construction: integral reconstruction
statement:
Fix a finite-field datum $D=(p,a,q,k_0,k)$ with $k=\overline{k_0}$, a prime $\ell\ne p$, and finite extensions $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ with valuation rings $R_E$, uniformizers $\varpi_E$, and $A_{E,n}=R_E/\varpi_E^n$ for $n\ge1$ [def-weil-finite-field-fiber, def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension]. Let $X,Y$ be finite-type $k$-schemes and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $k$-morphism; neither $X$ nor $Y$ is assumed separated over $k$ [def-weil-scheme-morphism-properties]. Fix a compactification $c=(X\xrightarrow j\overline X\xrightarrow{p_c}Y)$ [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Write $\mathcal C_{T,R_E}$ for the full bounded constructible derived-complete category over the completed coefficient sheaf $\widehat R_{E,T}$, with common finite cohomological and Tor intervals for all derived reductions [def-weil-derived-complete-integral-detailed, def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], and $I_{T,R_E}$ for its inclusion in the ordinary derived category. Write $\mathcal R_T$ for the derived reduction system, $\mathcal L_T$ for total derived inverse limit, and $\mathsf N_T$ for normalized strict coefficient systems whose every level $M_n$ lies in the bounded constructible finite-Tor category $D^b_{ctf}(T_{\mathrm{proet}},A_{E,n})$ [def-weil-finite-tor-amplitude], with those same common bounds: each transition-adjoint $A_{E,n}\otimes^L_{A_{E,m}}M_m\to M_n$ is an isomorphism [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. The actual reduction/total-limit adjunction $\mathcal R_T\dashv\mathcal L_T$ restricts to an equivalence $\mathcal C_{T,R_E}\simeq\mathsf N_T$. Its unit is the compatible quotient cone from a flat-term K-flat representative, identified with the derived-completeness map; its counit is the scalar adjunct of the actual total-limit projection. For the proper/open system adjunction transported from the ordinary etale system adjunction put
$$F_R=\mathcal L_Y\mathsf F^{pro}\mathcal R_X,\qquad G_R=\mathcal L_X\mathsf G^{pro}\mathcal R_Y.$$
They form an additive exact adjunction on the integral finite-Tor categories, with transported system units and counits, coherent shifts and shift-compatible unit and counit. Their finite reductions are the fixed finite operations with their system evaluation comparisons, and their constructible cohomological and Tor bounds are uniform in $n$.

One may choose $F_R$ to be the prescribed reduction-tower compact-support functor $P_R$ [def-weil-integral-rational-qbar-compact-support]. Let $h_R:I_{Y,R}P_R\xrightarrow{\sim}(Rp_{c,*}j_!)I_{X,R}$ be the inverse of the canonical ambient-to-tower realization of the single proper/open word. For the identification $u:F_R\xrightarrow{\sim}P_R$ there is a shift-compatible realization $r_R:I_{Y,R}F_R\xrightarrow{\sim}(Rp_{c,*}j_!)I_{X,R}$ such that $I_{Y,R}(u)=h_R^{-1}\circ r_R$. The proper/open, termwise and Roos-cone shift structures on these same normalized maps agree. This is an equality of actual integral maps, not an inference from their finite evaluations.
